text: Presence 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 SSH 远程开发插件，通过每台主机复用的持久连接，将远程目录接入为工作区，并注册远程文件与命令工具。它支持在远端执行命令、读取和编辑文件、搜索路径、管理后台作业、等待任务条件、查看日志及转发端口；文件面板和终端也可在远程工作区中使用。适合需要从本地 DSH 操作 SSH 主机的开发者。需要预先配置可用的 SSH 主机。

Presence connects DSH Web to SSH hosts and exposes remote folders as workspaces. Tools run commands, read and edit files, search paths, manage background jobs, wait for conditions, inspect logs, and forward ports. The file panel and terminal can work on remote hosts; configure SSH access first.

Presence 的远程命令功能：通过 SSH 连接在指定主机运行 shell 命令，可设置工作目录，也能将命令作为后台作业启动并获取运行信息。
Presence 的远程文件功能：读取、批量读取、写入和编辑 SSH 主机上的文件，并可通过搜索、glob 与状态查询定位目标。
Presence 的远程工作区功能：将主机目录映射到 DSH 文件系统，供工作区文件树与内置文件操作访问。
Presence 的等待与作业功能：等待远程文件、进程、端口或后台作业满足条件，并查询作业状态。
Presence 的端口转发功能：检查远程端口并通过 SSH 隧道将其转发到本机。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Presence：**Your SSH hosts, as local tabs.** Persistent remote workspaces, native file editing, search, exec, terminals and port forwards for coding agents — with **nothing installed on the remote host**. [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Releases](docs/RELEASE.md) · [MCP server](mcp/README.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rjfan/dsh-presence) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/presence-mcp) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) ---

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Presence：> ⚠️ **A local session is not bound to a remote workspace.** Opening a remote workspace in
> Presence does not turn a local agent session into a remote one. When your session's
> working directory is outside the presence mounts root, `presence_exec` and every other
> `presence_*` tool require an explicit `host` (or `PRESENCE_HOST`); without one they refuse
> with the session's cwd instead of silently running on the last-activated machine. Sessions
> started inside a remote workspace resolve to that machine automatically. See
> [Known limits](#known-limits).

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Why：Running an agent on every remote machine means installing it N times, upgrading it N
times and configuring proxies per host. Running `ssh host '<command>'` from the local
agent means a new handshake per command, no native file tools and no continuity.

Presence keeps the agent local and **extends its reach through one persistent SSH
connection per host**. The remote side is still plain `sshd`: SFTP, exec and a PTY.

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Why：| Approach | Cost |
| --- | --- |
| Install the agent on every host | N installs, N upgrades, per-host proxying |
| `ssh host '<command>'` per call | Handshake per command, no file tools, no sessions |
| **Presence** | One connection per host, native tools, nothing installed remotely |

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Features：- **Remote zero-install** — uses only `sshd` built-ins: the SFTP subsystem, exec channels and a PTY.
- **One handshake** — a pool keeps one connection per host; every later call is a request on it.
- **Native remote tools** — `rg`/`grep` runs on the target, commands run in the target shell; path, permission and encoding semantics are the remote ones.
- **Local-like edits** — atomic writes, mode preservation, ambiguity refusal, read-before-write guard, `presence_edit` with dry-run diffs.
- **Real workspaces** — a remote directory becomes a normal DSH workspace with a file tree and terminals that open **on the remote machine**.
- **Sessions are scoped (0.20 hotfix)** — a local session no longer silently borrows the last-activated remote workspace: `presence_*` needs an explicit `host` or `PRESENCE_HOST`, and the system prompt tells each session whether it is local or remote.
- **Conditions instead of sleeps** — `presence_wait` blocks on a file (`exists`/`minBytes`/`mtimeAfter`), a grep match count, a process (`pid`/`pattern`), a port state or a job id; a timeout is `met:false`, not an error.
- **Jobs that survive a restart** — background jobs are

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 2. Pick a host and open a workspace：Open **Settings → Presence → New**, choose a host from `~/.ssh/config` (or paste a
manual `ssh` command), then pick a remote folder. It appears as a workspace; the
left sidebar, file tree, terminal and agent tools all use that remote directory.

A session started in that workspace is remote. A session started anywhere else (for
example a normal local project) stays local: it must pass `host` explicitly — or set
`PRESENCE_HOST` — before calling `presence_exec` / `presence_*`.

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · How it works：```text
┌───────────────────────────────┐
│  DSH plugin  /  MCP server    │  two shells, one kernel
└──────────────┬────────────────┘
               │

| Agent operation | Channel | Remote dependency |
| --- | --- | --- |
| read / write / edit / list / stat | SFTP subsystem | `sftp-server` (stock sshd) |
| exec, search (`rg`/`grep`), git | exec channel | commands already on the host |
| interactive terminal | shell channel + PTY | the host's login shell |

Measured on a Linux host:

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · How it works：| Operation | Latency |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh host '<cmd>'` (new connection every time) | 520–540 ms |
| Presence connect (one handshake, key auth) | 145 ms |
| Presence `sftp stat` | p50 0.6 ms / p95 0.9 ms |
| Presence `exec true` (new channel + shell) | p50 7.6 ms |
| 8 concurrent exec channels | 15 ms total |

> Keep TCP_NODELAY on: without it, request/response hits delayed ACK and p95 goes
> from 0.9 ms to 48 ms.

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Tools：The DSH plugin exposes 25 tools. Inside a remote-workspace session relative paths
resolve against that workspace and `host` is optional; a **local** session must pass
`host` explicitly (or configure `PRESENCE_HOST`) — there is no fallback to the globally
last-activated workspace. Argument aliases are accepted at execute time
(`path`/`file_path`/`filePath`, `old`/`oldString`, `new`/`newString`, `cwd`/`workdir`, …),
so an agent's habitual spelling still works.

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Long-running tasks：- `presence_jobs { action: "status" }` gives a snapshot; `stop` terminates the process
  group and verifies the port was released. Jobs persist to `~/.dsh/presence/jobs.json`:
  after a DSH restart a job shows `unknown` until a liveness probe succeeds (never a false
  `running`) and its exit code may be missing.
- `logPath` is the job log to tail — the command's stdout/stderr on current kernels.
  `commandLogPath` is the command's own log; it equals `logPath` unless the kernel records
  a separate wrapper log, so tail `commandLogPath ?? logPath`.
- `presence_wait` replaces hand-written sleep+tail loops: wait for a port
  (`presence_wait { port: { port: 8000, state: "open" } }`), a checkpoint
  (`presence_wait { file: { path: "/data/ckpt.pt", minBytes: 1000000 } }`), a log line or
  a process. A timeout returns `met:false` — a normal answer, not an error.
- While a wait runs, the **wait dock** floats at the bottom right of the chat: elapsed time,
  `done/total unit`, an ETA computed from the sample rate, the last log line, and a
  click-through detail view (job id, log path, samples). It polls `/presence/api/waits`; an
  older host sim

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Safety and recovery：- **Destructive commands never run unconfirmed.** `rm -r/-f`, `git clean -fdx`,
  `find -delete`, `shred`, `truncate` and `dd of=` are first replayed with
  no-op shims to expand their real targets; unset variables and protected paths
  (workspace root, home, `/`, `.git`) are refused. A second call with
  `confirm:true` is required to execute. A rejected mixed command also lists the
  segments that are safe on their own (`Safe segments you can run separately:`);
  `confirm:"partial"` runs only those. Removing one file with a literal
  `rm -f <path>` inside the workspace is exempt — it cannot remove a tree.
- **Prefer `presence_trash`** for anything under a workspace: it moves the path to
  `~/.dsh/presence-trash/<timestamp>/` and returns a restore hint.
- **Writes are atomic** and keep the original file mode; `presence_edit` refuses
  ambiguous anchors instead of guessing.
- **Read before write**: built-in `read`/`write`/`edit` share a read-before-write
  guard. Path keys are canonicalised across `presence://`, mount paths, workspace-relative
  and absolute remote paths, and successful `presence_read` / `presence_write` /
  `presence

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Configuration：| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PRESENCE_HOST` | — | Default SSH host for **local** sessions (explicit opt-in; also used by the MCP server). Remote-workspace sessions ignore it in favour of their mounted host. |
| `PRESENCE_WORKSPACE` | — | `host:/abs/path` to bind a remote workspace. |
| `PRESENCE_JOBS_FILE` | `~/.dsh/presence/jobs.json` | Override the persisted background-job registry path. |
| `PRESENCE_PASSWORD_<ALIAS>` | — | Password for a host; `<ALIAS>` is uppercase with non-alphanumerics replaced by `_`. |
| `PRESENCE_MAX_CHANNELS` | 8 | Concurrent channels per connection. |
| `PRESENCE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` | 25000 | Connection attempt timeout. |
| `PRESENCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | 900000 | Idle connection timeout (connections with terminals are kept). |
| `PRESENCE_READ_ONLY` | false | Refuse writes/edits; reads, search and exec still work. |
| `PRESENCE_SFTP_TIMEOUT_MS` | 30000 | Per-SFTP-request timeout; a stalled connection becomes an error instead of a pending call (1–300 s). |
| `PRESENCE_SFTP_RETRIES` | 1 | Extra attempts for read-only SFTP requests on transient failures (0–3). |

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · Known limits：- **Local sessions.** A local session calling `presence_*` without `host` now raises
  `this session is local (cwd=...); pass an explicit host ...`. That is the intended 0.20
  behavior, not a bug: the old silent fallback to the last-activated remote workspace could
  run commands on another session's machine. Pass `host` per call, or set `PRESENCE_HOST`
  once as the explicit opt-in default; a local session still never inherits another
  session's workspace, and `presence_hosts`' `default` is session-scoped for the same reason.
- The read-before-write guard cannot observe shell output: `presence_exec { command:
  "cat file" }` (or `sed -n`) does **not** mark the file as read; `presence_read` and the
  built-in `read` do, and `presence_write`/`presence_edit` count as reads. A guarded
  built-in `edit` after only `exec cat` can still fail.
- The mount path (`~/.dsh/presence/mounts/...`) is virtual: it works through
  `ctx.fs` / agent tools, but native apps (Explorer, Office, host Python) cannot
  see it — use `presence_export` first.

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 为什么不是「agent 跑在远端」：在每台服务器上装 agent，意味着装 N 次、升级 N 次、逐台配代理；让本地 agent 每次
`ssh host '<command>'`，意味着每条命令一次握手、用不上原生文件工具、上下文不连续。

Presence 让 agent 留在本机，**通过每台机器一条常驻 SSH 连接把能力伸到远端**。远端
仍然只是普通的 `sshd`：SFTP、exec 和一个 PTY。

| 方案 | 代价 |
| --- | --- |
| 每台机器装 agent | N 次安装、N 次升级、逐台代理配置 |
| 每个操作 `ssh host '<cmd>'` | 每条命令一次握手、无文件工具、无会话 |
| **Presence** | 每台机器一条连接、原生工具、远端零安装 |
section: 为什么不是「agent 跑在远端」

text:
@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 特性：- **远端零安装** —— 只用 `sshd` 自带能力：SFTP 子系统、exec 通道和 PTY。
- **一次握手** —— 连接池为每台机器保持一条连接，之后的调用都是这条连接上的请求。
- **用目标机的原生工具** —— `rg`/`grep` 在目标机跑，命令在目标 shell 里执行；路径、权限、编码都是远端的语义。
- **接近本地的编辑** —— 原子写、保留 mode、锚点歧义拒绝、读后写守卫、`presence_edit` 的 dry-run diff。
- **真正的远程工作区** —— 远端目录注册成普通 DSH 工作区，文件树、终端都**开在远端机器上**。
- **会话有作用域（0.20 热修）** —— 本地会话不再静默借用上一次激活的远程工作区：`presence_*` 必须显式传 `host` 或配置 `PRESENCE_HOST`；系统提示会告诉每个会话自己是本地还是远程工作区。
- **条件等待，不用 sleep** —— `presence_wait` 等文件（`exists`/`minBytes`/`mtimeAfter`）、grep 命中数、进程（`pid`/`pattern`）、端口状态或任务 id；超时返回 `met:false`，不是错误。
- **任务跨重启存活** —— 后台任务持久化到 `~/.dsh/presence/jobs.json`，带 pid/pgid；`logPath` 是要 tail 的任务日志，`commandLogPath` 是命令自己的日志（当前内核里等于 `logPath`；只有内核提供独立包装日志时才不同），用 `commandLogPath ?? logPath`；重启后状态是 `unknown` 直到探活，不会假装 `running`，退出码可能缺失。
- **批量传输与追加写** —— `presence_import`/`presence_export` 支持 `paths[]`（1–50）或 glob，逐文件返回；`presence_write { mode:"append" }` 追加写。
- **可恢复的删除** —— 危险 shell 命令先 dry-run；`presence_trash` 移入远端回收站并可恢复。
- **`@` 能补全远端文件** —— 远程工作区里，文件引用补全直接索引目标机（`rg --files`，回退 `find`），不是本地镜像。
- **文件操作不只是读** —— `presence_mkdir` / `move` / `copy` / `chmod`，文件树右键菜单直接操作；删除走可恢复回收站。
- **Diff 与实时日志** —— 两个远端文件、或远端与本

└──────────────┬────────────────┘
               │

| Agent 操作 | 通道 | 远端依赖 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 读 / 写 / 编辑 / 列目录 / stat | SFTP 子系统 | sshd 自带 `sftp-server` |
| 执行命令、搜索（rg/grep）、git | exec 通道 | 目标机已有的命令 |
| 交互式终端 | shell 通道 + PTY | 目标机的登录 shell |

Linux 主机上的实测：

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 工作原理：| 操作 | 延迟 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh host '<cmd>'`（每次新连接） | 520–540 ms |
| Presence 建连（一次握手，含密钥认证） | 145 ms |
| Presence `sftp stat` | p50 0.6 ms / p95 0.9 ms |
| Presence `exec true`（新通道 + shell） | p50 7.6 ms |
| 8 个 exec 通道并发 | 合计 15 ms |

> 必须保持 TCP_NODELAY：否则请求/响应会撞上 delayed ACK，p95 从 0.9 ms 劣化到 48 ms。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 工具：DSH 插件提供 25 个工具。在远程工作区会话里，相对路径相对该工作区、`host` 可省略；**本地** 会话必须显式传 `host`（或配置 `PRESENCE_HOST`）—— 不会回退到全局最后激活的工作区。执行时 接受参数别名（`path`/`file_path`/`filePath`、`old`/`oldString`、`new`/`newString`、 `cwd`/`workdir` 等），习惯写法都能用。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 路径与工具怎么选：| 路径在哪 | 用什么 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工作区挂载目录下（`~/.dsh/presence/mounts/...`） | 内置 `read` / `write` / `edit` / `grep` / `glob` | 都直达远端机器；`grep`/`glob` 会自动路由过去 |
| 工作区之外的远端绝对路径（`/data`、`/scratch`、GPFS） | `presence_read` / `write` / `edit` / `stat` / `search` / `glob`（列目录用 `presence_exec`） | 内置工具只看得到挂载目录，看不到整台机器 |
| 本地文件（预览或 Office） | 先 `presence_export`，再 `present` / 原生打开 | 挂载路径是虚拟的，只有真实本地文件能被原生程序打开 |

**本地**会话（cwd 不在挂载根下）里内置工具只操作本地文件；每个 `presence_*` 调用都需要显式
`host`，或一次性配置 `PRESENCE_HOST`。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 长时间任务：- `presence_jobs { action: "status" }` 取快照；`stop` 结束进程组并验证端口已释放。任务持久化到
  `~/.dsh/presence/jobs.json`：DSH 重启后先显示 `unknown`，直到探活成功（不会假装 `running`），
  退出码可能缺失。
- `logPath` 是要 tail 的任务日志（当前内核里就是命令输出）；`commandLogPath` 是命令自己的日志，
  没有独立包装日志时等于 `logPath`，所以用 `commandLogPath ?? logPath`。
- `presence_wait` 取代手写 sleep+tail 循环：等端口
  （`presence_wait { port: { port: 8000, state: "open" } }`）、等 checkpoint
  （`presence_wait { file: { path: "/data/ckpt.pt", minBytes: 1000000 } }`）、等日志行或等进程。
  超时返回 `met:false`，是正常结果而不是错误。
- 等待进行中时，聊天右下角会悬浮一个**等待面板**：已用时间、`done/total unit`、按采样速率
  算出的剩余时间、最后一行日志，点开可看详情（job id、日志路径、采样记录）。它轮询
  `/presence/api/waits`；旧版 host 会自动隐藏。想要进度条和 ETA 就给 `presence_jobs wait`
  传 `progressPattern`/`progressUnit`，或给 `presence_wait` 传 `progressTotal`/`progressUnit`。
- 交互式任务：`presence_terminal { action: "open", session: "train" }`，tmux 会话跨重连存活。
- **不要**在前台 `presence_exec` 里用 `nohup`、`tmux new-session` 或结尾 `&` 跑长任务：登录节点
  会话结束时，集群可能清理残留进程。`background: true` 本身用 `setsid` 脱离；调度器管理的集群
  请用集群自己的启动器（`rlaunch -d …`、`salloc`/`sbatch`），让调度器持有任务。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 安全与恢复：- **危险命令不会直接执行。** `rm -r/-f`、`git clean -fdx`、`find -delete`、`shred`、
  `truncate`、`dd of=` 会先用 no-op shim 重放以展开真实目标；未设置变量和受保护路径
  （工作区根、家目录、`/`、`.git`）直接拒绝。必须再带 `confirm:true` 才会执行。被拒绝的
  混合命令还会列出可单独执行的安全分段（`Safe segments you can run separately:`），
  `confirm:"partial"` 只执行这些分段；工作区内对单个文件的字面量 `rm -f <路径>` 免检
  （它不可能删掉一棵树）。
- **工作区内删除优先 `presence_trash`**：移动到 `~/.dsh/presence-trash/<时间戳>/` 并返回恢复提示。
- **写入是原子的**，保留原文件 mode；`presence_edit` 锚点不唯一时报错而不是猜。
- **读后写守卫**：内置 `read`/`write`/`edit` 共享读后写守卫。路径 key 会在 `presence://`、挂载路径、
  工作区相对路径、远端绝对路径之间归一；`presence_read` / `presence_write` / `presence_edit` 成功都算
  「已读」（写也算）。`presence_exec` 里 `cat file` **不算** —— 守卫看不到 shell 输出；编辑前请用
  `presence_read` 或内置 `read`。

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 配置：| 变量 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PRESENCE_HOST` | — | **本地**会话的默认 SSH 主机（显式 opt-in；MCP server 也用）。远程工作区会话优先使用自己的挂载主机。 |
| `PRESENCE_WORKSPACE` | — | `host:/abs/path`，绑定一个远程工作区。 |
| `PRESENCE_JOBS_FILE` | `~/.dsh/presence/jobs.json` | 覆盖后台任务持久化文件路径。 |
| `PRESENCE_PASSWORD_<ALIAS>` | — | 某台机器的密码；`<ALIAS>` 大写、非字母数字换成 `_`。 |
| `PRESENCE_MAX_CHANNELS` | 8 | 每连接并发通道数。 |
| `PRESENCE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` | 25000 | 连接尝试超时。 |
| `PRESENCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | 900000 | 空闲连接回收时间（持终端连接不回收）。 |
| `PRESENCE_READ_ONLY` | false | 拒绝写入/编辑；读取、搜索、执行不受影响。 |
| `PRESENCE_SFTP_TIMEOUT_MS` | 30000 | 单次 SFTP 请求超时；连接假死时返回错误而不是一直 pending（1–300 秒）。 |
| `PRESENCE_SFTP_RETRIES` | 1 | 只读 SFTP 请求遇到瞬时错误的重试次数（0–3）。 |

@rjfan/dsh-presence README · 已知边界：- **本地会话（有意行为）。** 本地会话不传 `host` 调 `presence_*` 现在会报

  旧逻辑会静默复用上一次激活的远程工作区，可能在别的会话的机器上执行命令。每次调用传 `host`，
  或一次性配置 `PRESENCE_HOST` 作为显式默认值；本地会话仍然不会继承别的工作区，
  `presence_hosts` 的 `default` 同样是会话作用域。

  文件标记为已读；`presence_read` 和内置 `read` 才算，`presence_write`/`presence_edit` 也算已读。
  只 `exec cat` 过再让内置 `edit` 编辑，仍可能触发守卫。
- 挂载路径（`~/.dsh/presence/mounts/...`）是虚拟的：对 `ctx.fs` / agent 工具有效，
  但 Explorer、Office、宿主 Python 看不到 —— 需要先用 `presence_export`。
